summary: I have been waiting for this video. I have been roasting for over ten years commercially. I have realized that there are so many variables and differences in personal preference that very few people actually have any idea how they want their coffee roasted. They just want it to taste good. I can serve the same coffee to three different people who each order a light, medium and dark roast and they all love it. Aside from processing method, there is also little difference with origin flavor that can be detected days apart. Bottom line is not burning the beans by passing the second crack and using it while it is fresh will satisfy 99% of people. When people ask me about the kind of roast I tell them it’s a “right roast”.
